intelligence.enrichment: In a pinhole camera, light rays from an object pass through a tiny hole and form an upside-down image on a screen. Light from the object passes through the pinhole to the screen, so the screen receives an image that is upside down. The learner correctly applies this rule: In a pinhole camera, light rays from an object pass through a tiny hole and form an upside-down image on a screen. Any image made by light should be upright like a mirror image.
